description_en: Allows a user to replace a personal file resource that they created and triggers the system to re-parse the file
description_zh: 允许用户替换其创建的个人文件资源，并触发系统重新解析该文件
name: ReplaceSourceFile

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass this value explicitly by using --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the personal FILE data source to be replaced. This ID is unique within the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 待替换的个人 FILE 数据源 ID（租户内唯一）
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS persistent address of the new file, returned by the upload signing operation
parameters.help_zh: 新文件的 OSS 持久化地址（由上传签名接口返回）
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en: The public access URL of the new file. The URL may contain a temporary signature
parameters.help_zh: 新文件的公开访问 URL（可能携带临时签名）
parameters.name: file_public_url

parameters.help_en: The file record ID of the new file
parameters.help_zh: 新文件的文件记录 ID
parameters.name: file_record_id

parameters.help_en: The new file name. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter or set it to an empty string, the original file name is retained
parameters.help_zh: 新文件名（可选；不传或空字符串时保持原文件名）
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously wait for re-parsing to complete. Default value: false, which indicates asynchronous queuing
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步等待重新解析完成；默认 false，异步入队
parameters.name: force_sync

200.description_en: 替换个人资源文件并重新解析
200.description_zh: 替换个人资源文件并重新解析

schema.description_en: The response for replacing a personal resource file and triggering re-parsing
schema.description_zh: 替换个人资源文件并重新解析

filePath.description_en: The OSS persistent address of the file after replacement
filePath.description_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址

filePublicUrl.description_en: The OSS persistent address of the file after replacement
filePublicUrl.description_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址

fileRecordId.description_en: The file record ID after replacement
fileRecordId.description_zh: 替换后的文件记录 ID

message.description_en: The description of the status code

sourceType.description_en: The data source type. The value is fixed to FILE
sourceType.description_zh: 数据源类型，固定为 FILE

status.description_en: The data source status after re-parsing
status.description_zh: 重新解析后的数据源状态
status.title_en: 重新解析后的数据源状态
status.title_zh: 重新解析后的数据源状态
